Abdul El-Sayed Wins Michigan Democratic Senate Primary

Abdul El-Sayed won the Democratic Senate primary in Michigan, advancing to face Republican Mike Rogers in November. El-Sayed, who is Muslim and of Egyptian descent, is considered a progressive candidate. His victory has been compared to that of former New Jersey state official and progressive politician, Zohran Mamdani. El-Sayed is vying to become the first Muslim senator from Michigan.
